name: @gobing-ai/spur-desktop
description: Spur desktop shell. Electron loads the Board from a child Bun server and does not open SQLite.
author: Robin Min <minlongbing@gmail.com>

scripts.build:js: bun build src/main.ts --outfile dist/main.js --target node --format esm --external electron && bun build src/preload.ts --outfile dist/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.pack: bun run stage && bun run build:js && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
